newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson seeks to block June 13 merger vote. [CORRECTED 22:26 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson seeks to block June 13 merger vote. [CORRECTED 22:26 GMT]

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson & Co asked a Delaware judge Tuesday for an injunction that would block Great Western Financial Corp shareholders from voting on a proposed merger with Washington Mutual Inc on June 13.

Ahmanson's request was in response to a letter earlier Tuesday in which Great Western told Vice Chancellor Jack Jacobs of the Delaware Chancery Court that it intended "to hold the vote on the proposed merger with Washington Mutual on June 13, 1997 -- the same day fixed by Great Western for the delayed election of directors."
Ahmanson wants a court order that would require at least six weeks between the June 13 meeting to determine the directors of Great Western and any vote on the merger.
The judge is scheduled to meet with both sides Tuesday afternoon to set dates for court hearings.
(Corrects to remove assertation that Ahmanson's slate of directors has been elected to Great Western's board.)
